{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers (using customer_segment)
completed_loyal = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if there are any such orders
print(f'Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {len(completed_loyal)}')

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_loyal['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')

# Verify the result
print(f'Completed orders from LOYAL customers: {completed_loyal.head().to_string()}')"}
